answer: An applicant who owns a whisper, owes a meadow and outlasted a voyage is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. Curing a proof takes 8 days, and a farm holding 677 proofs cannot cure them side by side. One proof settles it, and it reads Puppetmaker toy soldier warrant counted beside the guild hall, spelled out in full as each toy soldier is a run of sanded edges logged against the master pattern.
